spells.name: Aid
spells.description: Choose up to three creatures. Each target’s Hit Point maximum and current Hit Points increase by 5 for the duration.
spells.upcast: HP increase increases by 5 for each level above 2.

spells.name: Alter Self
spells.description:
Alter your form. Choose one option (can swap as a Magic action):
- **Aquatic Adaptation:** Gills and webbed fingers. Breathe underwater and gain Swim Speed equal to Speed.
- **Change Appearance:** Alter appearance (height, weight, voice, etc.). Size and basic shape stay same.
- **Natural Weapons:** Grow claws, fangs, horns, or hooves. Unarmed Strikes deal 1d6 (Slashing/Piercing/Bludgeoning) and use spellcasting modifier for attack/damage rolls.

spells.name: Animal Messenger
spells.description: Target a Tiny Beast. Force a Charisma save (auto-success if CR > 0). Specify location and recipient. Beast travels and delivers a message (up to 25 words) when it arrives.
spells.upcast: Duration increases by 48 hours for each level above 2.

spells.name: Arcane Lock
spells.description: Magically lock a door, window, or container. Can't be opened nonmagically. You and designated creatures can open it. Password unlocks it for 1 minute.

spells.name: Arcane Vigor
spells.description: Regain HP by rolling one or two unexpended Hit Point Dice plus your spellcasting modifier.
spells.upcast: Roll one additional Hit Point Die for each level above 2.

spells.name: Augury
spells.description: Receive an omen about an action you plan in the next 30 minutes: Weal (good), Woe (bad), Weal and Woe (both), or Indifference (neither). Cumulative 25% chance of no answer if cast multiple times per Long Rest.

spells.name: Barkskin
spells.description: Touch a willing creature. Its skin becomes bark-like; its AC is 17 if it was lower.

spells.name: Beast Sense
spells.description: Touch a willing Beast. Perceive through its senses and your own, gaining any special senses it has.

spells.name: Blindness/Deafness
spells.description: Force a Constitution save. Fail: target is Blinded or Deafened (your choice). Repeat save at end of its turns.
spells.upcast: Target one additional creature for each level above 2.

spells.name: Blur
spells.description: Your body becomes blurred. Any creature has Disadvantage on attack rolls against you. Creatures with Blindsight or Truesight are immune.

spells.name: Calm Emotions
spells.description: Each Humanoid in a 20-foot-radius Sphere makes a Charisma save. Fail: choose for each: (1) Immunity to Charmed/Frightened (suppresses existing), or (2) Indifferent to hostile creatures of your choice (ends if it or allies take damage).

spells.name: Cloud of Daggers
spells.description: Conjure spinning daggers in a 5-foot Cube. Creatures in or entering the Cube take 4d4 Slashing damage (once/turn). Use a Magic action to teleport the Cube up to 30ft.
spells.upcast: Damage increases by 2d4 for each level above 2.

spells.name: Continual Flame
spells.description: An object you touch sheds Bright Light (20ft) and Dim Light (+20ft). The flame creates no heat and consumes no fuel. Can be covered but not quenched.

spells.name: Crown of Madness
spells.description: One Humanoid makes a Wisdom save or is Charmed. They must use their action before moving to make a melee attack against a creature you choose. They repeat the save at the end of their turns. You must use a Magic action each turn to maintain control.

spells.name: Darkness
spells.description: Fills a 15-foot-radius Sphere with magical darkness. Darkvision can't see through it. Alternatively, fill a 15-foot Emanation from an object not worn/carried. Dispels Light spells of level 2 or lower.

spells.name: Darkvision
spells.description: Touch a willing creature to grant it 150ft of Darkvision.

spells.name: Detect Thoughts
spells.description: Use a Magic action to Sense Thoughts (know thinking creatures within 30ft) or Read Thoughts (learn surface thoughts within 30ft). Probing deeper forces a Wisdom save; failure reveals reasoning and emotions. Probed creature knows you are reading it.

spells.name: Dragon's Breath
spells.description: Willing creature can use a Magic action to exhale a 15-foot Cone. Creatures in area make a Dexterity save or take 3d6 damage (Acid, Cold, Fire, Lightning, or Poison).
spells.upcast: Damage increases by 1d6 for each level above 2.

spells.name: Enhance Ability
spells.description: Touch a creature and choose an ability: Strength, Dexterity, Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma. The target has Advantage on checks with that ability.
spells.upcast: Target one additional creature for each level above 2.

spells.name: Enlarge/Reduce
spells.description: Enlarge or reduce a creature or object (unwilling creatures make a Con save). Enlarge: size +1 category, Adv on Str checks/saves, +1d4 damage. Reduce: size -1 category, Disadv on Str checks/saves, -1d4 damage (min 1).

spells.name: Enthrall
spells.description: Chosen creatures make a Wisdom save (auto-success if in combat). Fail: -10 penalty to Perception and Passive Perception.

spells.name: Find Steed
spells.description: Summon an Otherworldly Steed (Celestial, Fey, or Fiend). It shares your Initiative and can be a controlled mount. If you heal with a level 1+ spell, it heals the same amount within 5ft. It vanishes at 0 HP or if you die.

actions.name: Otherworldly Slam
actions.description: 1d8 + level Radiant (Celestial), Psychic (Fey), or Necrotic (Fiend) damage.

bonus_actions.name: Fell Glare (Fiend)
bonus_actions.description: Frighten a creature within 60ft until end of your next turn (1/Long Rest).

bonus_actions.name: Fey Step (Fey)
bonus_actions.description: Teleport steed and rider up to 60ft (1/Long Rest).

bonus_actions.name: Healing Touch (Celestial)
bonus_actions.description: Heal a creature within 5ft for 2d8 + level (1/Long Rest).

spells.name: Find Traps
spells.description: Sense the presence and general nature of any trap in range and line of sight. Doesn't reveal location.

spells.name: Flame Blade
spells.description: Create a fiery blade. Use a Magic action to make a melee spell attack: 3d6 + spellcasting modifier Fire damage. Sheds 10ft Bright Light, 10ft Dim Light.
spells.upcast: Damage increases by 1d6 for each level above 2.

spells.name: Flaming Sphere
spells.description: Create a 5ft sphere. Creatures ending turns within 5ft make a Dex save or take 2d6 Fire damage. As a Bonus Action, move it 30ft; hitting a creature forces a save.
spells.upcast: Damage increases by 1d6 for each level above 2.

spells.name: Gentle Repose
spells.description: Touch a corpse to protect it from decay and prevent it becoming Undead. Extends time limit for resurrection.

spells.name: Gust of Wind
spells.description: Create a 60ft Line of wind. Creatures in or entering area make a Strength save or be pushed 15ft. Moving closer costs 2ft per 1ft. Disperses gas; can extinguish flames. Bonus Action to change direction.

spells.name: Heat Metal
spells.description: Choose a manufactured metal object. Creatures in contact take 2d8 Fire damage. Use a Bonus Action each turn to deal damage again. Target makes a Con save or must drop the object; if they don't, they have Disadvantage on attacks and checks.
spells.upcast: Damage increases by 1d8 for each level above 2.

spells.name: Hold Person
spells.description: Force a Humanoid to make a Wisdom save or be Paralyzed. They repeat the save at the end of their turns.
spells.upcast: Target one additional Humanoid for each level above 2.

spells.name: Homunculus Servant
spells.description: Summon a Tiny Construct (AC 13, HP 5 + 5xlevel). It shares your Initiative and obeys commands (no action required). It has Evasion and can deliver Touch spells (Reaction). It vanishes if you die.

traits.name: Evasion
traits.description: No damage on successful Dex save for half; half on failure. Inactive if Incapacitated.

traits.name: Magic Bond
traits.description: Add spell level to its ability checks and saving throws.

actions.name: Force Strike
actions.description: 1d6 + level Force damage (5ft reach or 30ft range).

reactions.name: Channel Magic
reactions.description: Deliver a Touch spell cast by you while within 120ft.

spells.name: Invisibility
spells.description: Touch a creature to grant it the Invisible condition. Ends early if they attack, cast, or deal damage.
spells.upcast: Target one additional creature for each level above 2.

spells.name: Knock
spells.description: Unlock a mundane lock or bar. Suppresses Arcane Lock for 10 minutes. Emits a loud knock audible up to 300ft.

spells.name: Lesser Restoration
spells.description: Touch a creature to end one condition: Blinded, Deafened, Paralyzed, or Poisoned.

spells.name: Levitate
spells.description: Rise a creature or loose object (up to 500 lbs) vertically up to 20ft. Unwilling creatures make a Con save. Move target up to 20ft altitude on your turn (uses Magic action if not you). Target floats gently down when the spell ends.

spells.name: Locate Animals or Plants
spells.description: Learn distance and direction to closest specified Beast, Plant creature, or nonmagical plant within 5 miles.

spells.name: Locate Object
spells.description: Sense direction to a familiar object within 1,000ft. Can locate specific objects seen within 30ft or the nearest object of a kind. Blocked by lead.

spells.name: Magic Mouth
spells.description: Implant a message (max 25 words) in an object. Message plays when a visual or audible trigger occurs within 30ft. Can choose for spell to end after one use or repeat.

spells.name: Magic Weapon
spells.description: Touch a nonmagical weapon to give it a +1 bonus to attack and damage rolls.
spells.upcast: Bonus increases to +2 (L3-5 slot) or +3 (L6+ slot).

spells.name: Melf's Acid Arrow
spells.description: Make a ranged spell attack. On a hit, target takes 4d4 Acid damage and 2d4 Acid damage at the end of its next turn. On a miss, target takes half of the initial damage only.
spells.upcast: Both initial and later damage increase by 1d4 for each level above 2.

spells.name: Mind Spike
spells.description: Target makes a Wisdom save. Fail: 3d8 Psychic damage and you always know its location (while on same plane); it can't hide and gets no benefit from Invisibility vs you. Success: half damage.
spells.upcast: Damage increases by 1d8 for each level above 2.

spells.name: Mirror Image
spells.description: Create three illusory duplicates. When hit, roll d6 for each remaining duplicate: if any roll 3+, a duplicate is hit instead and destroyed. Duplicates ignore other damage/effects. Ends when all 3 are destroyed. Blinded creatures or those with Blindsight/Truesight are unaffected.

spells.name: Misty Step
spells.description: Teleport up to 30 feet to an unoccupied space you can see.

spells.name: Moonbeam
spells.description: Create a 5ft-radius, 40ft-high Cylinder of pale light. Creatures entering, ending turns, or starting in the area (when cast/moved) make a Constitution save. Fail: 2d10 Radiant damage and shape-shifted creatures revert. Success: half damage. Use Magic action to move it 60ft.
spells.upcast: Damage increases by 1d10 for each level above 2.

spells.name: Nystul's Magic Aura
spells.description: Place an illusion on a creature (Mask: change perceived creature type) or object (False Aura: change perceived magical properties). Lasts until dispelled if cast daily for 30 days.

spells.name: Pass without Trace
spells.description: Radiate a 30-foot Emanation. You and chosen creatures in it have a +10 bonus to Dexterity (Stealth) checks and leave no tracks.

spells.name: Phantasmal Force
spells.description: Craft an illusion in one creature's mind (max 10ft Cube). Target makes an Intelligence save; fail means they perceive and rationalize it as real. Can deal 2d8 Psychic damage per turn if hazard/creature. Study action vs spell DC to end.

spells.name: Prayer of Healing
spells.description: Up to five creatures in range gain the benefits of a Short Rest and regain 2d8 HP. A creature can't benefit again until a Long Rest.
spells.upcast: Healing increases by 1d8 for each level above 2.

spells.name: Protection from Poison
spells.description: Touch a creature to end the Poisoned condition. For the duration, the target has Advantage on saves vs Poisoned and Resistance to Poison damage.

spells.name: Ray of Enfeeblement
spells.description: Target makes a Constitution save. Success: Disadvantage on its next attack roll until your next turn. Fail: Disadvantage on Strength-based D20 Tests and subtract 1d8 from all its damage rolls for the duration. Target repeats the save at the end of its turns.

spells.name: Rope Trick
spells.description: A rope you touch creates an extradimensional space at its upper end (3x5ft portal). Space holds up to eight Medium or smaller creatures. Effects can't pass the portal, but those inside can see out. Objects/creatures fall out when the spell ends.

spells.name: Scorching Ray
spells.description: Hurl three fiery rays at one or more targets. Make a ranged spell attack for each: 2d6 Fire damage on hit.
spells.upcast: Create one additional ray for each level above 2.

spells.name: Searing Orb
spells.description: Make a ranged spell attack: 3d4 Radiant damage on hit. Hit or miss, the orb explodes: target and creatures within 10ft make a Constitution save or be Blinded until the end of its next turn.
spells.upcast: Damage increases by 1d4 for each level above 2.

spells.name: See Invisibility
spells.description: See Invisible creatures/objects as if visible. See into the Ethereal Plane (objects appear ghostly).

spells.name: Shatter
spells.description: Each creature in a 10-foot-radius Sphere makes a Constitution save. Fail: 3d8 Thunder damage. Success: half damage. Constructs have Disadvantage. Nonmagical objects also take damage.
spells.upcast: Damage increases by 1d8 for each level above 2.

spells.name: Shining Smite
spells.description: Take as a Bonus Action immediately after hitting with a Melee weapon or Unarmed Strike. Target takes extra 2d6 Radiant damage. Until the spell ends, it sheds 5ft Bright Light, attack rolls against it have Advantage, and it can't be Invisible.
spells.upcast: Damage increases by 1d6 for each level above 2.

spells.name: Silence
spells.description: Create a 20-foot-radius Sphere where no sound can be created or pass through. Creatures inside are Deafened and have Immunity to Thunder damage. Spells with Verbal components cannot be cast.

spells.name: Spider Climb
spells.description: Touch a willing creature to grant it a Climb Speed equal to its Speed and the ability to move across vertical surfaces and ceilings with hands free.
spells.upcast: Target one additional creature for each level above 2.

spells.name: Spike Growth
spells.description: Ground in a 20-foot-radius Sphere becomes Difficult Terrain. A creature takes 2d4 Piercing damage for every 5ft it moves within the area. Camouflaged: requires Search action (Perception/Survival vs spell DC) to recognize.

spells.name: Spiritual Weapon
spells.description: Create a floating weapon and make a melee spell attack within 5ft for 1d8 + spellcasting modifier Force damage. As a Bonus Action, move it 20ft and attack again.
spells.upcast: Damage increases by 1d8 for each level above 2.

spells.name: Suggestion
spells.description: Suggest an achievable course of action (max 25 words) to a creature that can hear and understand you. Target makes a Wisdom save or is Charmed and follows the suggestion. Ends if you or allies damage it.

spells.name: Summon Beast
spells.description: Summon a Bestial Spirit (Air, Land, or Water). It shares your Initiative and obeys commands (no action required). It can Multiattack (rend attacks = half spell level).

companion_stats.name: Bestial Spirit
companion_stats.speed: 30 ft (Climb 30ft Land, Fly 60ft Air, Swim 30ft Water)

traits.name: Flyby (Air)
traits.description: No Opportunity Attacks when flying out of reach.

traits.name: Pack Tactics (Land/Water)
traits.description: Advantage on attack rolls if an ally is within 5ft.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: Makes rend attacks equal to half spell level (round down).

actions.name: Rend
actions.description: Melee spell attack: 1d8 + 4 + level Piercing damage.

spells.name: Tortoise Shell
spells.description: Touch a willing creature to grant a +3 bonus to AC. If they move, the bonus reduces to +1 until the start of their next turn.

spells.name: Warding Bond
spells.description: Create a mystic connection with a willing creature within 60ft. Target gains +1 AC, +1 to saves, and Resistance to all damage. Each time they take damage, you take the same amount. Ends if you drop to 0 HP or move >60ft away.

spells.name: Web
spells.description: Create a 20ft Cube of webs (Difficult Terrain, Lightly Obscured). Must be anchored or it collapses after 1 turn. Creatures entering or starting turns in it make a Dexterity save or are Restrained. Break free with a Strength (Athletics) check vs spell DC. Webs burn away in 1 round if ignited.

spells.name: Zone of Truth
spells.description: Create a 15ft-radius Sphere. Creatures entering or starting turns in it make a Charisma save. Fail: they can't speak a deliberate lie. You know if they succeed or fail.

spells.name: Aganazzar's Scorcher
spells.description: A line of roaring flame 30ft long and 5ft wide. Each creature in the line must make a Dexterity save or take 3d8 Fire damage (half on success).
spells.upcast: Damage increases by 1d8 for each level above 2.

spells.name: Air Bubble
spells.description: Create a spectral globe of fresh air around a willing creature's head. Grants ability to breathe in any environment.
spells.upcast: Create two additional globes for each level above 2.

spells.name: Borrowed Knowledge
spells.description: Choose one skill you lack proficiency in. You gain proficiency in that skill for the duration.

spells.name: Dust Devil
spells.description: Summon an elemental force in a 5ft Cube. Creatures ending turns within 5ft make a Strength save or take 1d8 Bludgeoning damage and are pushed 10ft. Move it 30ft as a Bonus Action. Can form a 10ft-radius debris cloud if moved over loose earth (Heavily Obscured).
spells.upcast: Damage increases by 1d8 for each level above 2.

spells.name: Earthbind
spells.description: Force a Strength save. Fail: target's Fly Speed becomes 0. Airborne targets descend 60ft/round until grounded.

spells.name: Flock of Familiars
spells.description: Summon three familiars (animal forms). They act as a unit. Can deliver Touch spells if within 100ft.
spells.upcast: Summon one additional familiar for each level above 2.

spells.name: Fortune's Favor
spells.description: Grant luck to a creature. Target can roll an extra d20 on an attack, check, or save and choose which to use. Or use it when attacked to choose between rolls.

spells.name: Gift of Gab
spells.description: Take a Reaction when speaking to make the creature forget everything you said in the last 6 seconds and resay something else.

spells.name: Healing Spirit
spells.description: Summon a nature spirit (5ft Cube). Creatures entering or starting turns there heal 1d6 HP (max heals = 1 + spellcasting modifier). Move it 30ft as a Bonus Action.
spells.upcast: Healing increases by 1d6 for each level above 2.

spells.name: Immovable Object
spells.description: Touch an object (<10 lbs) to fix it in place. Can hold 4,000 lbs. Designated creatures can move it. Strength check vs spell DC to move it 10ft.
spells.upcast: L4-5: DC+5, 8,000 lbs, 24h duration. L6+: Permanent, DC+10, 20,000 lbs.

spells.name: Jim's Glowing Coin
spells.description: Hurl a distracting coin. Creatures within 10ft that see it make a Wisdom save or be distracted (Disadv on Perception and Initiative). Bonus Action to move it 60ft.

spells.name: Kinetic Jaunt
spells.description: Walking speed +10ft, no Opportunity Attacks. Can move through creature spaces (don't end turn there or take 1d8 force damage and get shunted).

spells.name: Maximillian's Earthen Grasp
spells.description: Earthen hand rises in a 5ft square. Target makes Strength save or takes 2d6 Bludgeoning damage and is Restrained. Use an Action to crush (2d6 bludgeoning; Strength save for half) or move the hand to a new target.

spells.name: Nathair's Mischief
spells.description: Fill 20ft Cube with fey energy. Roll for effect: 1: Apple Pie (Charmed), 2: Flowers (Blinded), 3: Giggles (Incapacitated), 4: Itching Powder (Speed halved). Move cube 10ft and reroll each turn.

spells.name: Pyrotechnics
spells.description: Extinguish a 5ft Cube fire for an effect: **Fireworks** (10ft radius, Con save or Blinded) or **Smoke** (20ft radius, Heavily Obscured for 1 min).

spells.name: Rime's Binding Ice
spells.description: Each creature in a 30ft cone makes a Constitution save. Fail: 3d8 Cold damage and Speed 0 for 1 min (or until ice is broken as an Action). Success: half damage.
spells.upcast: Damage increases by 1d8 for each level above 2.

spells.name: Shadow Blade
spells.description: Create a magic sword (Finesse, Light, Thrown 20/60). Deals 2d8 Psychic damage. Advantage in Dim Light/Darkness. If thrown/dropped, vanishes at end of turn; re-summon as Bonus Action.

spells.name: Skywrite
spells.description: Form up to ten cloud-words in the sky. Dissipates when ends or by strong wind.

spells.name: Snilloc's Snowball Swarm
spells.description: A 5ft-radius sphere of snowballs. Each creature in area makes a Dexterity save or takes 3d6 Cold damage (half on success).
spells.upcast: Damage increases by 1d6 for each level above 2.

spells.name: Spray of Cards
spells.description: Spray spectral cards. Creatures in 15ft cone make a Dexterity save. Fail: 2d10 Force damage and Blinded until end of their next turn. Success: half damage.
spells.upcast: Damage increases by 1d10 for each level above 2.

spells.name: Tasha's Mind Whip
spells.description: Force an Intelligence save. Fail: 3d6 Psychic damage and no Reactions until end of next turn; on next turn, can only Move, Action, OR Bonus Action. Success: half damage.
spells.upcast: Target one additional creature (within 30ft) for each level above 2.

spells.name: Vortex Warp
spells.description: Teleport a creature to a space you can see within range. Target makes a Constitution save; fail teleports them. Space must support target.
spells.upcast: Range and teleport distance increase by 30ft per level above 2.

spells.name: Warding Wind
spells.description: 10ft-radius wind surrounds you: deafens area, extinguishes small flames, hedges out gas/fog, area is Difficult Terrain for others, and ranged attacks have Disadvantage passing through.

spells.name: Wither and Bloom
spells.description: 10ft-radius sphere: chosen creatures make a Constitution save or take 2d6 Necrotic damage (half on success). One chosen creature in area can spend/roll a Hit Die to heal (roll + spellcasting mod).
spells.upcast: Damage increases by 1d6 for each level above 2.

spells.name: Wristpocket
spells.description: Vanish an object (<5 lbs) into an extradimensional pocket. Action to summon/store it again. Drops at feet if spell ends and hand is full.
